answer: Radio-beacon signal proof: each identity must stream a live signal from its own $18 beacon — one beacon per fake, 8 hours of setup and calibration each — registered to a distinct cedar grove on the public map. The network pings each beacon at a random minute; it must answer within 2 seconds with a fresh signed nonce, and two identities answering from one radio fingerprint burn the whole grove at once. An honest agent buys one beacon once and keeps working. Limit: a rich farm can still buy beacons, just never cheaply.
